summary: Timeline Panel and Auto-Sync features fully tested. Backend: 11/11 tests passed (100%) - POST /api/editor/auto-sync generates missing voices via Google TTS, analyzes audio durations with ffprobe, and returns optimized slide durations. POST /api/audio/duration returns audio file duration. Frontend: Timeline toggle button (data-testid='timeline-toggle-btn') toggles CapCut-style multi-layer timeline panel. All 5 layers visible (Video/indigo, Voice/emerald, Caption/amber, Music/pink, SFX/cyan). Auto Sync button generates 2 voices and syncs timing. Zoom controls, expand/collapse, close button all work. Lock/unlock buttons present on each layer.

issues: Clicking timeline blocks with playhead shows selection, but slide highlight could be more prominent. Current implementation works but visual feedback is subtle.

critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/editor/auto-sync (server.py:1404-1520): Well-structured endpoint that generates missing TTS voices, uses ffprobe for audio duration analysis, calculates optimal slide durations based on voice length + buffer. Returns comprehensive sync data including bgmInfo with loop/trim recommendations.
POST /api/audio/duration (server.py:1523-1535): Simple helper endpoint for frontend timeline to get audio file durations. Checks uploads, music, and sfx directories.

TimelinePanel.jsx: Clean React component with proper state management for zoom (0.5-4x), expanded/collapsed view, layer locking. Uses buildBlocks callback to construct timeline from slide data. Auto-sync makes API call and applies returned durations to slides via updateSlide.
EditorPage.jsx: Timeline toggle state (showTimeline) controlled via data-testid='timeline-toggle-btn'. TimelinePanel receives all necessary props for slide/project sync.
